name: ergosphere
description: Lists the libraries copied into vendor/ so vulnerability scanners can see them. Nothing installs them: the app serves vendor/ as is. vendor/xterm.js is lib/xterm.js of @xterm/xterm without its last sourceMappingURL line, vendor/xterm.css is its css/xterm.css, vendor/addon-fit.js is lib/addon-fit.js of @xterm/addon-fit. tests/vendor_manifest_test.py checks that they match.
